name: composer
description: Builds a literature corpus that can be cited without checking it again. Harvests PubMed, downloads the Open Access full texts through the legitimate PMC OA / Europe PMC routes, and admits a paper only when it (a) has a readable full text on disk and (b) survives 5-dimension bibliographic validation — DOI, first author, author list, journal and volume — cross-checked against Crossref, PubMed and Europe PMC, with a 2-of-3 majority rule so one publisher's malformed deposit cannot reject a real paper. Every search gets its own directory with the exact query, the date, the true hit count and the gate result, logged to PRISMA 2020 / PRISMA-S and tied to a PROSPERO protocol record. Deterministic and LLM-free: retrieval and verification are mechanical, screening stays a human judgement.
